tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All General Conditions of Eligibility as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer must have a NABL Certified laboratory, Proof of documents for the existence of the laboratory and certification should be submitted or if the MOU/Agreement signed for tie-up with any other recognized laboratories, a copy of the subsisting MOU / agreement establishing the tie-up from 2023 till 2027 or above and the valid accredited certificate of the tied up laboratory should be submitted. Tenderer should have a tie up with the laboratory during tender / contract period.
The tenderer shall have valid accredited certificate approved by MoEF& CC / National Accreditation Board of Education and Training (NABET).

Audited balance sheet and profit and loss statement of the firm certified by Chartered Accountant for having achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 50.00 Lakhs during the past four financial years, i.e., 2022-23 to 2025-26.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

Audited balance sheet and profit and loss statement of the firm certified by Chartered Accountant for having achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 50.00 Lakhs during the past four financial years, i.e., 2022-23 to 2025-26.
Copy of Income Tax Returns filed for 2 two financial / Assessment Years during the three financial years, i.e., 2023-24 to 2025-26.
Copy of PAN and GST Registration Certificate

Status of the firm upload supporting document,1. Individual / proprietary- Firm registration certificate/GST in the name of the firm,2. Partnership firm- Partnership deed / Registration Certificate of the firm,3. Private / Public Limited Company- Certificate of Incorporation
Technical proposal submission form as per 3A
Tenderers information in 3-B duly filled and signed.

The tenderer must have a laboratory, Proof of documents for the existence of laboratory should be submitted or if the MOU/Agreement signed for tie-up with any other recognized laboratories, a copy of the subsisting MOU / agreement establishing the tie-up from 2023 till 2027 or above and the valid accredited certificate of the tied up laboratory should be submitted. Tenderer should have a tie up with the laboratory during tender / contract period.
The tenderer shall have valid accredited certificate approved by MoEF and CC or National Accreditation Board of Education and Training NABET.

The tenderer should have obtained Environmental Clearance for not less than two projects Mines opencast from MoEF Impact Asse Division SEIAA in last five financial years 2022-23 to 2026-27 The date of issue of communicating environmental clearance by MoEF SEIAA is the criteria to consider eligibility. Documentary proof about entrusting the assignment by Mine Owners for obtaining environmental clearance from MoEF SEIAA to be provided. As per tender document
Undertaking regarding non- blacklisting / non-debarment as per 3C.
Valid NABL Laboratory certificate for the laboratory or MoU signed along with valid NABL Laboratory Certificate for tie-up with any other recognized accredited laboratories should be submitted.
